verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents several built-in AI assistant surfaces you can hand work to. These include PR chat for follow-ups and challenges (docs-6, docs-52), one-click agentic actions such as fixing findings, resolving merge conflicts, generating tests and running custom recipes (docs-13), and command-driven code improvements (docs-26, docs-53). It also offers a Slack agent for investigation, planning and code editing (docs-19, docs-27), Coding Plans (docs-30) and Change Stack chat (docs-55). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation, since the community evidence covers only review quality.
